## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe what changes for the user, with a concrete trigger or example when useful.

## Scope and decisions

Link the issue and owning document. Explain material architectural or contract changes and relevant tradeoffs.

## Validation

List the checks actually run and their results. Identify unrun checks and limitations. For hardware or performance work, link the rig profile, workload, and measurement method. For UI changes, include relevant desktop/mobile and supported language screenshots.

## Report

Link the self-contained HTML report. Use synthetic examples and exclude participant data and credentials.
